segments.name: Retail
segments.description: Operates store and digital channels selling fashion apparel, accessories and home goods to consumers under its consumer brands.
segments.evidence: Our Retail segment includes our store and digital channels and primarily includes our Anthropologie, Free People, FP Movement and Urban Outfitters brands.

segments.name: Subscription
segments.description: Runs the Nuuly brand, a monthly women's apparel subscription rental service for customers.
segments.evidence: Our Subscription segment includes the Nuuly brand, which offers customers a more sustainable way to explore fashion primarily through a monthly women's apparel subscription rental service.

segments.name: Wholesale
segments.description: Designs and markets women's apparel, intimates, activewear and shoes sold to department and specialty stores worldwide.
segments.evidence: We operate a Wholesale segment under the Free People, FP Movement and Urban Outfitters brands.

revenueModel.text: Retail customers pay for merchandise in stores and online, subscribers pay for monthly apparel rental, and department and specialty stores pay wholesale.
revenueModel.evidence: In addition to retail stores, we offer our products and services directly to our customers through our websites, mobile applications, social media and third-party digital platforms and customer contact centers.
